name: Matsuno Todomatsu
source: The sixth and the youngest brother. He is carefree and somewhat effeminate, which leads to some success with other girls, but still has his limits concerning his brothers, who he tries to keep his personal life away from. His distinguishing feature is his smaller mouth and he often dresses in pink.
